summary: A council sets aside its budget vote after nearly every speaker opposes it, trims small lines and returns later.
realLife: A city's hearing drew fourteen speakers, all but one against a tax rise that would lift the average bill by about fifteen percent on top of an earlier levy override. At the meeting, a cut to a bike share line passed, a cut to staff training failed, a cut to council travel passed and a mayor's pay raise was reversed. Three hours in, the council moved to table the rest.
sources: The Cornell Daily Sun (Ithaca, New York), 'Common Council tables budget vote after residents criticize proposed tax increases', Nov 7, 2024: https://cornellsun.com/2024/11/08/common-council-tables-budget-vote-after-residents-criticize-proposed-tax-increases/
